A1_paloma_fig1.src: Paloma, Magnusson et al. 2024, arXiv 2312.10523 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.10523), Fig. 1 (fig: figures/models_by_ppl_over_all_tasks.pdf), ordinary perplexity over all Paloma sources minus 3 fringe sources and code; 1B params, ~150B tokens, decontaminated, matched order

A3b_redpajama_t5_pileval.src: arXiv 2411.12372 Table 5, Pile validation perplexity; 468M, 100B tokens
